title: Firefox profile folders
whyItMatters: Firefox keeps one folder per profile for browsing history, cookies, saved logins and form data. The set of profiles and their names shows who used the browser and for what.
source: Mozilla Support, profiles where Firefox stores user data: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/profiles-where-firefox-stores-user-data
notes: Each profile folder is named <random>.default, <random>.default-release or a user-chosen name. Crash Reports and other non-profile folders live next to Profiles, not inside it.

cleanup.exportFirst: Export bookmarks to an HTML file from Firefox Library > Import and Backup, and export saved logins from Logins and Passwords.
cleanup.signOut: In Firefox, open the account menu and sign out of your Mozilla account, so the profiles stop syncing with it.
steps: Open the Firefox profile manager and remove each profile listed there.
Delete the Firefox profile folders named in the plan if they are still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes every Firefox profile on this PC: history, cookies, saved logins, form data, extensions and open sessions.
cleanup.source: Mozilla Support, Profile Manager - Create, remove or switch Firefox profiles: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/profile-manager-create-remove-switch-firefox-profiles
